notes_for_editor: Rodeo Butte (other name in the record) is not confirmed as this site. The oregonlookouts item places the 1943 tower in the Klamath FPA area near Bly; the register puts McCartie Ranch in Lake County 9 miles north of Bly. Build year is decade-only. No access level found in any source read; visit fields left out. Search returned only a Montana McCart lookout, which was not used. The three cited sources do not link Rodeo Butte to McCartie Ranch; the register page does not mention Rodeo.
